text:
alyssa: heads up — noticed invoice preview spike for a handful of tenants around 03:12 UTC, looks correlated with epoch-join processing on the ingest pipeline

sam: saw that too, digging logs now. small subset of events got assigned epoch_id=null then later reprocessed with epoch. billing join doubled token counts in preview window

mira: can you paste an example log line? curious if this is a routing race or join-order nondeterminism

sam: here's a representative snippet from ingest-debug:
```
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:01Z ingest-handler request_id=ri_8a2 epoch_id=null route_tag=embed-heavy tokens=129 status=accepted
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:02Z joiner commit request_id=ri_8a2 epoch_id=epoch-20260322-03 route_tag=embed-heavy tokens=129 status=joined
```

jordan: so we emit a provisional metering event without epoch, then emit final with epoch. downstream tallyer treats them as two distinct line items => duplicate credits until dedupe runs

alyssa: exactly. dedupe runs eventually but preview shows both, hence invoice drift. not a huge user charge, but noisy and confusing in console

mira: any reason we can't add a provisional flag to preview pipeline to hide provisional events until final commit? might be simpler UX fix than changing dedupe semantics

sam: we could, but provisional flag needs to propagate through multiple consumers, and affects SLA for near-realtime dashboards. also some customers depend on provisional metrics for anomaly detection

jordan: alternative: include epoch_id in the provisional event as soon as it's deterministically known (we sometimes know epoch earlier but join ordering causes null). Make the upstream producer wait ~50ms for epoch assignment when request rate is low — small added latency but reduces duplicates massively

alyssa: tradeoff between latency and accounting correctness. Can we make it tunable per route? e.g., for high-sensitivity billing routes add small stall, default to no-wait for low-latency routes

mira: that ties into routing policy config we already have (route-level qos flags). console UX could expose a new toggle: "billing-consistent-mode" with description and latency impact estimate

sam: engineering notes: implementation would be a change in edge-proxy to attach provisional_epoch when available, fallback null if not after wait. Then metering-ingest uses `provisional_epoch || eventual_epoch` to dedupe before emitting preview. Also add a new telemetry counter: `metering.provisional_wait_ms` and `metering.duplicate_preview_count`

ops-bot: alert muted for tenant X while investigating (ticket #INC-4821) :information_source:

jordan: for immediate mitigation we can add a quick console filter: hide duplicate-preview events where request_id matches a final-commit within 5m. low-risk UX change and reversible. Should be scoped to preview only, not final invoices

alyssa: agree — short term: console filter + alert rule suppression. medium term: upstream provisional_epoch attach + `metering.provisional_wait_ms` telemetry + per-route toggle. long term: rethink ingest join ordering to provide deterministic epoch earlier

mira: who wants the tasks? I can own console filter and rollout UX copy for the new toggle

sam: I’ll PR the edge-proxy wait + telemetry counters, add a feature flag behind `ingest.bump/provisional_epoch`

jordan: I’ll update metering-ingest dedupe logic and add e2e test that simulates late-join ordering and asserts no duplicate preview items

alyssa: timeline: quick console filter today, feature-flagged infra change in the next 2 days, e2e + gradual canary over 1 week. Ops: hold alerts on similar preview spikes for 24h after canary

eng-telemetry-bot: New telemetry dashboards recommended: `metering/preview-duplicates`, `metering/provisional-wait-latency`, `metering/route-billing-modes` — auto-created in playground (viewers: eng-platform, billing)

mira: noted — I'll draft the console modal wording: "Enable billing-consistent-mode for this route. Slight increase in median p50 latency (~5-20ms) in exchange for reduced duplicate preview items and more stable invoice previews."

sam: quick follow-up: need to ensure logs have deterministic request_id until final commit. found a corner where retried clients get new request_id and that defeats dedupe. adding `client_request_id` passthrough might help

jordan: yep add `client_request_id` as secondary dedupe key in dedupe table. update docs and SDK header mapping

alyssa: great. let's sync at 11:00 PT in eng-platform channel after we have PRs linked. thanks team :thumbsup:

mira: adding PR links here when ready, will also include screenshots for console modal copy

sam: PR: https://git.redwood.company/edge-proxy/pulls/812 (WIP)

jordan: PR: https://git.redwood.company/metering-ingest/pulls/129 (WIP)

alyssa: leaving this thread open for followups. if anyone sees another preview spike tag me and drop logs.
